messages.subject: Unexpected behaviour with facet_grid
parts:
I am running 0.82 ggplot2 on R 2.81 on an Ubuntu 64 box. 

I have encountered the following anomaly in how facet performs.

See data and code below:

myData <- read.table(textConnection("A Males 1.1 1.5 1.9
A Females 0.7 0.9 1.1
B Canada 0.3 0.5 0.9
B US 1.2 1.6 1.9"))
closeAllConnections()
myData

cairoplot3 <- ggplot(myData, aes(x=V2,  ymin=V3, max=V5, y=V4))+geom_crossbar(aes(colour=V1))+facet(. ~ V1)
cairoplot3


I had expected that each facet would only include those values of V2 which were associated with the specific value of  V1 (that is, the facet for valueV1= A  would have columns for male and female, but not for Canada and the US, and similarly that the facet for  V1=B would have columns for "Canada" and "US", but no columns for Males and Females.

Cairoplot produces two facets as expected, except each facet has four labelled columns (Males, Females, Canada, US).  In the facet for V1=A, there are (appropriately) no data plotted for Canada or the US) and for the facet for V1=B, there are columns for Males and Females, but no data. 

Might this be a bug?

Many thanks


Rob James

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Unexpected behaviour with facet_grid
parts:
Hi Rob,

You probably want:

+ facet_grid(. ~ V1, scales = "free_x", space = "free")

The scales are common by default.

Hadley
